about_short_description.short_description: Emburse is a provider of expense management and accounts payable automation solutions.

product.name: Emburse Expense Intelligence
product.description: An AI-enabled spend management platform that provides real-time visibility, automated expense capture and categorization, policy enforcement, compliance controls, and forecasting across travel, expenses, AP, cards, and payments.

product.name: Emburse Expense Enterprise
product.description: Enterprise expense management software for automating expense capture, reporting, approvals, reimbursements, policy enforcement, and financial integration across complex organizations.

product.name: Emburse Travel Management
product.description: Corporate travel management software for policy-compliant booking, pre-trip approvals, traveler support, supplier optimization, auditing, and automated savings across air and hotel programs.

product.name: Emburse Invoice & AP Automation
product.description: Accounts payable and invoice automation software that digitizes invoice intake, purchasing, approvals, processing, and payment workflows while improving visibility into costs and cash flow.

product.name: Emburse Payments
product.description: Business payment automation for reimbursements and vendor payments using methods such as ACH, virtual cards, and checks, with controls for cash flow, security, and reconciliation.

product.name: Emburse Cards
product.description: Integrated corporate card management with physical and virtual card issuance, spending controls, transaction visibility, reconciliation, and connection to expense workflows.
